verdict.rationale: Jina Reader ships an extensively documented public HTTP API (r.jina.ai) with numerous header-controlled options (output format, presets, chunking, cookies, JSON schema extraction, proxy routing) all detailed in first-party GitHub docs, directly enabling programmatic/agentic use. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/swagger probes returned 404, llms.txt 404), and independent confirmation beyond community auth-error reports which reflect expected key requirements rather than API failure.
